dr=N,vxc=δExcδn 孤立・球対称・閉殻1s²に限定した原子単位の動径式。RHFのvH/2は2電子同一空間軌道に特有。LDAは交換のみで相関なし。UHF、GGA、hybrid、一般分子・周期DFTの実行例ではない。 厳密解・参照解 閉殻HF・交換のみLDAの独立参照、SCF残差・電子数・格子収束を確認します。近似汎関数の解を厳密なHe多体解とは呼びません。 実行例の参照と結果 共通実行例 He：閉殻HF・交換のみLDA text.en: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM Helium ground state: closed-shell HF and exchange-only LDA Explore this problem’s equations, reference conditions, methods and published code. Saved result figure Computed from the public atomic-code fixed inputs, with conditions, CSV profiles, convergence checks and independent references linked in the reading. Equations and problem definitions Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters. Closed-shell Hartree–Fock equations F^=h^+∑j∈occ(2J^j−K^j),F^ϕi=εiϕi FC=SCε,C†SC=I Closed-shell RHF equations for occupied spatial orbitals generally include nonlocal exchange. Published examples cover the spherical 1s²-helium local reduction and fixed-input H₂ RHF using a separate molecular-integral implementation. Their bases, discretizations and references differ; inspect each input and validation record below. These examples do not validate general multicenter molecules, open shells or correlated methods. Local Kohn–Sham DFT E[n]=Ts[n]+∫vextn dr+EH[n]+Exc[n]+ENN [−12∇2+vext+vH+vxc]ϕi=εiϕi n(r)=∑ifi∣ϕi(r)∣2,∫n dr=N,vxc=δExcδn Representative local Kohn–Sham equations. Published examples cover spin-unpolarized exchange-only Dirac LDA for spherical helium and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation for fixed periodic He/He₂ cells. The radial atomic implementation and periodic PySCF workflows are separate series with different bases, boundaries and references. Inspect each input and validation record below; these examples do not validate GGA, hybrids, general materials or excited states. Formulations used by execution examples Common execution exampleApproximation or discretization Helium: closed-shell HF and exchange-only LDA [h^r+12vH[n]]u=εu(He 1s2 RHF) [h^r+vH[n]+vxLDA(n)]u=εu,vxLDA=−(3nπ)1/3 h^r=−12d2dr2−2r,n(r)=2∣u(r)∣24πr2 Atomic-unit radial equations restricted to isolated spherical closed-shell 1s² helium. The RHF vH/2 form is specific to two electrons sharing one spatial orbital. LDA is exchange-only, without correlation; no UHF, GGA, hybrid, general molecular or periodic-DFT example. Exact and reference solutions Check independent closed-shell HF/exchange-only LDA references, SCF residuals, electron number and mesh refinement. Approximate-functional solutions are not labeled exact many-body helium solutions. References and results of execution examples Common execution example Helium: closed-shell HF and exchange-only LDA PySCF 2.11.0 / Libxc finite-Gaussian references. Conditions, commands and validation scope Assumptions Nonrelativistic infinite-mass point nucleus, two electrons doubly occupying a single 1s spatial orbital. Second-order central differences and linear density mixing. Local HF exchange reduction is specific to this two-electron problem.
